comment: Recognition layer 2: community signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected into world space at load. radius = trigger zone in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review: true = uncertain entry (map data, not lived knowledge — owner's correction is authoritative).

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Gateway roundabout from the Palisadoes into Kingston — the city opens up here

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Windward Road corridor; Rockfort Mineral Baths just off the road

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: East Kingston residential community along Windward Road

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hilltop Rasta stronghold above Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's business district — hotels, embassies, financial houses

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Named for the cotton tree that marked the halfway point between Kingston and Spanish Town

communities.name: Hagley Park
communities.note: West Kingston residential corridor on the way out of the city

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital under Spanish and British rule — historic cathedral square

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Historic single-lane bridge over the Rio Cobre — the river runs almost level with the road

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the mouth of the dramatic gorge — 'bog' from Spanish 'vega' (valley)

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town made famous by the folk song 'Linstead Market' — Saturday market tradition

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hill village in the climb between Linstead and Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Junction town at the crest — where the road turns north to Ocho Rios

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: The legendary cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival since the 1960s

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre ravine dense with tropical ferns — a canopy-shaded descent into Ocho Rios

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann's tourist capital — cruise ships, Dunn's River Falls, and the end of the run
